steps.purpose: Open the target page. onError:continue — a heavy real page can make the navigate CALL return -32001 timeout while the page still loads; the next listen Page.loaded settles it.

params.expression: function chl(){var t=(document.title||'').toLowerCase();var u=(location.href||'').toLowerCase();var m=['just a moment','verify you are human','checking your browser','attention required','cloudflare','cf-chl','__cf_chl','challenge-platform'];return {challenge:m.some(function(s){return t.indexOf(s)>=0||u.indexOf(s)>=0;})?'yes':''};}return chl();

steps.purpose: P4 active-control boundary: detect a Cloudflare/CAPTCHA challenge by title/url (empty on the happy path → next step skipped, zero cost). Do NOT declare challengeFlag in variables (it is runtime-set; declaring it would make it a required input). AUTHORING RULE: this MUST stay a Runtime.evaluate whose extract fills the flag — skill_control.make_challenge_poller reverse-engineers exactly this pair (the `if $vars.<flag> matches → listen Hitl.resumed` boundary + the Runtime.evaluate that fills <flag>) to re-run the SAME JS on the 2nd connection for in-page polling; produce the flag with any OTHER action and in-page polling SILENTLY no-ops (only navigation-level onset still fires).
Read page structure so target element ids are resolved at runtime (never frozen)

then.purpose: Read the target section text into a scalar variable

else.purpose: Fallback: target id not resolved on first pass; re-read structure (content may have loaded late). Agent takeover continues from here if still missing.
